attempted_axis: STRUCTDRAFT-FIRST de-fakematch pass over the whole TU: draft the movie record with tools/gdl/structdraft.py, verify it against GC access widths + the full PDB index, place it as a file-local typedef, then convert every site with defake_rewrite.py in offsetof-rename form and byte-gate each batch.

attributes.law_screen: claim.law.embedded-struct-member-whole-tu-cascade APPLIED and honored -- MovieState was declared as a FILE-LOCAL typedef, never in include/game/*.h, and the typedef was gated ALONE (GATE OK) before a single site was converted, exactly as the law mandates. claim.law.offsetof-rename-preserves-protected-web APPLIED as the primary instrument: no base pointer was retyped anywhere, every conversion is a pure displacement respelling on the original u8*/int base, which is why 110 of 111 sites were byte-neutral. claim.law.multifield-alias-defeats-indexed-addressing APPLIED as a veto on the obvious alternative -- `movie` touches ~25 distinct nearby fields in fn_800DA6A4 and `param_1` 44 in fn_800DACD8, squarely the multi-field case this law says must NOT get a typed alias; no typed alias was introduced. claim.law.declared-alias-vs-repeated-cast and claim.law.write-site-alias-defeats-reload-parity: not applicable, no alias or repeated-cast form was used. claim.law.sizeof-defeats-loop-stride-induction APPLIED as a prohibition -- no sizeof() was substituted for any stride or literal. claim.law.offsetof-rename-array-member-boundary screened and found NOT to apply: the two u8[0x34] header members are only ever reached as offsetof() constants added to a plain base variable, never via array-to-pointer decay off a `->` expression. claim.law.offsetof-rename-isolated-site-outlier APPLIED and VINDICATED -- it predicted exactly the failure that occurred and prescribed the remedy that worked (bisect on any real movement, revert the single outlier to a bare literal). claim.law.lwzu-idiom-web-retention screened: no load-update (p += N) web exists on any of these four bases, so no site was protected by it. claim.law.walked-base-symbol-identity screened: gMovieStreamState is a single bounded pointer global assigned from the same allocation, not an overlapping blob, so no per-function relocation check was required. claim.law.large-fn-batch-fuzzy-can-mask-subfield-regression screened: every batch was gated on fndiff real via defake_gate, never on fuzzy, and no function here approaches the 4000-insn threshold.
attributes.residual: 20 bare sites remain, all deliberate and all outside the movie record: fn_800D96B0's `header` (12), MovieValidateFrameFormat's iVar2/iVar3 (11), fn_800D93D4/fn_800D87FC/fn_800D8BCC's `param_5` (8), fn_800D99AC's `dst` (5), fn_800D87FC/fn_800D8BCC's `entry` (4) and a few 1-2 site bases -- these are MovieBitmapHeader/MovieDecodeState views on OTHER bases, a separate cluster family this pass did not claim.
